summary:
Iteration 39 focused on re-verifying the InvoiceModal render-crash fixes from iteration 38. PRIMARY REGRESSION CONFIRMED FIXED: clicking an invoice card now OPENS [data-testid='invoice-modal'] cleanly — no ErrorBoundary fallback, no PAGEERROR — for an existing TEST_pytest card with ai_status='failed', invoice_date='', items=[]. All the safeDate / safeLocations / blob-url fixes work as designed: (1) the <input type='date' data-testid='invoice-date'> renders empty when source value is '' OR a free-form non-ISO string like '12 Feb 2026' (verified by PATCHing the doc with that value via API then re-opening — modal still opens, value coerces to ''), (2) [data-testid='invoice-location-select'] is enabled for super_admin and lists 5 locations, (3) [data-testid='invoice-delete'] is visible for admin, (4) [data-testid='invoice-image'] renders with a blob: URL — captured the underlying /api/admin/invoices/{id}/file GET via Playwright request interception and confirmed it carries an Authorization: Bearer header (200 OK), (5) the 'Loading image…' placeholder appears briefly before the blob resolves, (6) the AI-failed amber banner shows the exact copy 'AI couldn't read this invoice — fill in the fields manually.' with the ai_error sub-line 'AI provider error (emergent, 401): invalid x-api-key'. Backend regression: /app/backend/tests/test_invoices.py — all 7 pytest cases still pass. 

NEW CRITICAL UI BUG SURFACED: the [data-testid='invoice-save'] and [data-testid='invoice-delete'] buttons sit at the very bottom of the InvoiceModal (which is rendered with alignItems: 'flex-end' / maxHeight 92vh, bottom-drawer style, z-index 80). The JKHive footer nav [data-testid='jkhive-footer-nav'] is fixed at the bottom of the viewport with a higher effective stacking context — Playwright reported the footer's Manager <span>/<svg> 'intercepts pointer events' on every regular click of invoice-save (and invoice-delete). With force=True the click goes through BOTH the modal button AND the footer nav button beneath — the modal closes and the app navigates to /jkhive Manager. Verified via backend GET that the supplier change was NOT persisted (invoice supplier still '' after the click), confirming the click never actually fired on Save — it landed on the Manager nav tile underneath. SAME OVERLAP AFFECTS DELETE. Net effect: a real human user on the JKHive layout (footer always visible) cannot click Save or Delete in the modal — those buttons are unreachable on desktop 1280×900 and mobile 390×844 (footer nav is fixed in both). This blocks the admin amend / delete UX completely.

ui_bugs.issue:
JKHive footer-nav (fixed bottom, z-index higher than modal z=80) physically overlaps the Save and Delete buttons at the bottom of the InvoiceModal — Playwright records 'Manager from
subtree intercepts pointer events' on every normal click. force-clicking bubbles through and the user lands on the Manager tab without saving. Modal is rendered with alignItems: 'flex-end' (bottom drawer) and maxHeight: 92vh — fix by either (a) raising modal z-index above the footer (z-index: 200+), (b) padding the modal body bottom by the footer height (~64px) so Save sits above the footer line, or (c) centering the modal (alignItems: 'center') so its action row never hits the footer band. Documents modal likely has the same pattern — worth a sweep.

integration_issues.issue: PATCH never fires because the Save click is intercepted by the footer-nav Manager tab. Verified via backend GET that supplier stayed ''.
Same footer-nav overlap blocks the Delete button. Backend DELETE works (used it via curl to clean up the test doc).

action_items: Fix the InvoiceModal footer-nav overlap. Recommended one-liner: bump the modal z-index to 200+ AND/OR change alignItems to 'center' AND/OR add paddingBottom equal to JKHive footer height (around 72px) on the modal body so the Save/Delete row clears the footer. Re-test by clicking Save with NO force flag — it must register on the button and PATCH must persist.
Sweep other JKHive sub-page modals (Documents, Deliveries, Shifts) — they likely share the same bottom-drawer style and may have the same z-index conflict.
Once unblocked, re-run the amend flow end-to-end: edit supplier → Save → confirm card list shows new supplier; open another card → Delete → confirm card disappears.
critical_code_review_comments: Invoices.jsx InvoiceModal style: zIndex: 80 is lower than the JKHive footer-nav stacking context in practice — modals that float over a layout with persistent bottom nav should be ≥100.

Bottom-drawer modal (alignItems: 'flex-end') combined with a permanent bottom footer nav is a recurring papercut. Consider a shared <Modal/> component with safe-area padding that subtracts the footer height from maxHeight automatically.

safeDate() and safeLocations guards are clean and well-commented — good defensive code. The useEffect that creates and revokes the blob URL is also correct (revokes both on cancellation race and on unmount).
api.invoiceFileBlobUrl() mirrors documentsFileBlobUrl exactly — good consistency. Authorization header confirmed on the wire.

success_rate.frontend: 70% — modal opens cleanly, all defensive guards work, blob image + auth header verified, AI-failed banner correct, non-ISO date safe. BLOCKED: Save & Delete clicks unreachable due to footer-nav overlap.

test_credentials: Super admin: admin@jollys.com / Admin123! — used throughout. Note: backend rate-limits the login endpoint to 5/min — testing agent hit a 429 once and waited 60–75s before retrying. Future iterations should batch login.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_pytest_modal2.png scan against timperley-altrincham (ai_status='failed') to drive the modal-open test, and cleaned it up via DELETE /api/admin/invoices/1f804fd3-a3b at the end of the run. Confirmed the invoices collection is now empty for timperley-altrincham.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 38 hypothesis fixes are confirmed in iteration 39: modal renders, blob-url image works with Bearer header, safeDate / safeLocations / loading-placeholder are all correct, AI-failed banner copy is correct. The remaining blocker is purely a CSS z-index / layout overlap between the InvoiceModal bottom action row and the JKHive footer-nav. After main agent bumps the modal z-index (or restyles the action row position), re-run a single Playwright flow: click card → edit supplier → click [data-testid='invoice-save'] without force → assert modal closes AND supplier propagates to the card list AND GET /api/admin/invoices reflects the new supplier. Also click delete on a second card and assert backend 404 on its file. test_invoices.py pytest suite remains the green regression baseline (7/7).
rca of the issue: The modal action row contains <button data-testid='invoice-save'> and <button data-testid='invoice-delete'> as the LAST elements inside a position:fixed inset:0 z-index:80 container rendered with alignItems:'flex-end' (bottom-drawer). The JKHive layout simultaneously paints <nav data-testid='jkhive-footer-nav'> as a position:fixed bottom:0 element whose effective stacking context dominates (Playwright's hit-testing keeps returning the nav's span/svg as the click target). Result: real-user clicks on Save/Delete never reach those buttons — they land on Intelligence/Routines/Workforce/Manager tabs depending on horizontal position. Reproduction: login as admin@jollys.com / Admin123!, /jkhive/invoices, pick Timperley, click any card, attempt to click [data-testid='invoice-save'] without force — Playwright reports footer-nav intercepts. force=True closes the modal AND navigates to the underlying footer-nav target. Mitigation in /app/frontend/src/pages/jkhive/Invoices.jsx line 307: change `zIndex: 80` to `zIndex: 200` (or whatever is > the footer nav's z-index) and/or add `paddingBottom: 84` to the inner modal body so the action row clears the 72-px footer. Same investigation should be applied to other JKHive modals.
